salaryAndBenefitsIntro: Postgraduate physician salaries and benefits are set by the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors through ordinance or agreements with the Joint Council of Interns and Residents (JCIR).
medicalAndDentalBenefits: All fellows receive medical and dental benefits through the Lundquist Institute, fully covered by the program. Dependents are also eligible. Fellows may opt out but will not receive reimbursement for declined benefits.
housingStipend: A $10,000 housing stipend is provided annually to all active fellows each August (effective July 1, 2023).
educationalStipend: Reimbursement is available for up to two approved continuing medical education conferences per year, including registration, airfare, lodging, and per diem.
relocation: No relocation benefits are provided. Fellows are responsible for moving costs and required licensure (California medical license, board certification, CPR, CME coursework).
licensureFees: Fellows may apply for a DEA license fee exemption for services in Los Angeles County DHS facilities. AAHIVM HIV Specialist exam fees and study materials are reimbursed.
leaveTime: Each fellow receives 25 paid leave days annually for vacation, sick, or personal time.
